note: The raw fuzzer input is supplied as an in-memory OpenType/CFF font and parsed by FreeType.
A normal CFF Top DICT parser stack is allocated with CFF_MAX_STACK_DEPTH entries.
Numeric operands from the crafted CFF Top DICT are pushed until the parser stack is full.
In the vulnerable revision the operator path computed num_args when parser->top was already equal to parser->stack + parser->stackSize, without first rejecting the full stack.
The operator pointer is written one element past the heap-allocated parser stack, corrupting adjacent heap memory.
